purpose: Establish bridges as department-owned induction boundaries rather than global resources.
scope: Governance only. Does not modify existing SSOT structure.
core_principles: A bridge is a local departmental construct.
Every bridge belongs to exactly one department.
Canonical definitions never move across a bridge.
A bridge records lawful correspondence between departments.
Bridges inherit the governance of their owning department.

governance.rule_001: The owning department defines the bridge.
governance.rule_002: The foreign department remains canonical for its own definitions.
governance.rule_003: Bridges may translate terminology but may not redefine foreign primitives.
governance.rule_004: Bridge research debt is owned locally.
governance.rule_005: Bridge tasks belong to the owning department.
governance.rule_007: Reciprocal bridges are independent governance artifacts.

examples.meaning: Mathematical formalization motivated by physical interpretation.

ai_implications: Department AI loads local bridges only.
Cross-department reasoning proceeds through governed bridges.
No AI receives unrestricted global interpretation by default.
Bridge loading is explicit and auditable.
non_goals: Does not create a global bridges directory.
